## Quick summary

Explain the problem and what changes for the person affected in one to three short sentences.

## Verification

List the exact commands you ran and their results. Name skipped checks and known limits.
For UI changes, attach reviewed screenshots. For performance changes, link the method and before-and-after evidence.

## Related work

Link the issue, discussion, or approved plan. State the affected product and any package changeset.

## AI assistance

Describe material AI assistance and the checks you ran yourself, or write "None".

## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the entire diff and can explain the change.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant tests and documentation.
- [ ] I removed credentials and personal data from code, logs, and screenshots.
